# llm-cost-ledger

> In-process ledger of tokens and cost per LLM call with daily and monthly caps in a chosen time zone, one-time warnings and a pre-call budget check Python package `trysac-llm-cost-ledger`, import name `llm_cost_ledger`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
